# Retention policy → sweeper map (BE-057; 01 §3.3, §7; 02 §24.2). TestEveryRetentionPolicyHasSweeper
# reads it together with the retention_policies seed of db/migrations (000090, 000121):
#
#   <policy code>  <coverage>
#
# coverage  sweeper:<module>   a privacy.RetentionSweeper of the policy's owner module claims the code;
#                              kvkk.retention_sweep runs it (dry run until legally approved)
#           job:<job name>     a scheduled job applies the period (hooks.retention): operational data or a
#                              destruction that is never deferred to the legal approval
#           inline:<reason>    deleted in the transaction that ends the record (≥ 20 characters)
#           todo:BE-NNN        the code writing the table is not merged yet; the ticket adds the sweeper
#           none:<reason>      no sweeper by design (≥ 20 characters)
#
# Every seeded policy has exactly one line; a sweeper claiming an unknown code, a code claimed twice,
# a sweeper of another module than the owner, a missing job or a line without a seeded policy fails.

# platform (operational, independent of the legal approval; BE-006 jobs)
outbox_published              job:outbox.cleanup
webhook_payload               job:webhook_inbox.purge_payloads
webhook_row                   job:webhook_inbox.purge_payloads
idempotency                   job:idempotency.cleanup
# audit
audit_events                  sweeper:audit
audit_roots                   sweeper:audit
# files: unattached uploads (operational)
files_orphan                  job:files.orphan_cleanup
# identity
edu_document                  sweeper:identity
session_expired               job:identity.sessions_cleanup
email_token                   job:identity.email_tokens_cleanup
edu_verification_history      sweeper:identity
role_history                  sweeper:identity
privileged_action_history     sweeper:identity
dormant_account               none:disabled until the lawyer decides a period (T-36); placeholder 100 years
# consent
consent_proof                 sweeper:consent
terms_acceptance              sweeper:consent
iys_netgsm_event              job:consent.iys_netgsm_purge
unsubscribe_link              job:consent.unsubscribe_links_cleanup
# notify (01 §7 notify.purge)
notification_delivery         sweeper:notify
email_suppression             sweeper:notify
push_token                    sweeper:notify
in_app_notification           sweeper:notify
# orgs
membership_ended              sweeper:orgs
membership_ended_sensitive    inline:deleted in the transaction that ends it; orgs.purge_sensitive_memberships when a club becomes sensitive (T-83, T-208)
org_invitation                sweeper:orgs
# directory
club_claim                    sweeper:directory
# students: profile_access_grants (written by messaging's acceptance; revoked by the student or the company, BE-046)
access_grant_revoked          sweeper:students
# events
event_form_answers            sweeper:events
event_form_answers_sensitive  sweeper:events
event_staff                   sweeper:events
event_export_log              sweeper:events
event_export_file             job:events.purge_exports
# feed (01 §7 feed.purge_removed)
post_removed                  sweeper:feed
post_media_dropped            sweeper:feed
content_report                sweeper:feed
moderation_action             sweeper:feed
# outreach: the dispatch rows (BE-035): finished dispatches 2 years after created_at
outreach_dispatch             sweeper:outreach
# messaging: closed contact requests 12 months after closing (updated_at of the closed row; BE-056)
contact_request_closed        sweeper:messaging
# talent (BE-079): the ledger through talent.point_events_purge, then the unreferenced config versions
talent_ledger                 sweeper:talent
talent_counters               sweeper:talent
talent_runs                   sweeper:talent
talent_neutralization         sweeper:talent
# talent (BE-087, T-324): scores and cohorts deleted every night while collection is off (never deferred to the approval)
talent_collection_off         job:talent.recompute
# talent (BE-101, T-342): scores and cohorts of the users the nightly run no longer scores, with collection on
talent_score_dropped          job:talent.recompute
# entitlements
entitlement_other             sweeper:entitlements
# ledger (orders, payments, ledger, billing and parties tables; 06 H-57)
financial_records             sweeper:ledger
# kvkk
dsr_record                    sweeper:kvkk
dsr_export_file               job:kvkk.purge_exports
destruction_log               sweeper:kvkk
breach_record                 sweeper:kvkk
dsr_erasure                   none:a destruction_logs category of account erasures, written by the erasure run
